correction_notes: This is a corrected version of the original graph. Changes: (1) C3 edge P41->P45 reversed to P45->P41, since the leave-one-out necessity definition is the prerequisite mechanism for the reward formulation, not a consequence of it. (2) C8 edges P58->P56, P56->P61, and P61->P60 removed as unsupported by evidence (disjoint statements with no explicit textual/logical link); this split the original C8 into a smaller connected component (P59,P61,P62,P63,P64), a separate 2-node component (P56,P57), and two newly isolated nodes (P58, P60). (3) C9 edge P96->P97 removed since evidence presents P96's two effects as parallel/coordinate consequences joined by 'and', not a dependency; P97 moved to isolated_nodes. All other components are unchanged from the original graph.

structural_reasoning: This corrected graph resolves all previously flagged low-fidelity edges. The evaluation-results component (C1) and the data curation funnel (C2) remain fully coherent and unchanged. C3's reversed edge (P45->P41) now correctly reflects that the leave-one-out strategy definition precedes and grounds the reward formulation, resolving the prior directional error. The former C8 has been split into two clean components: a semi-supervised results component (C8, now P59/P61/P62/P63/P64) with only evidence-supported edges, and a small self-consistency-formula component (C9, P56->P57); the two nodes whose only edges were unsupported (P58, P60) are now correctly listed as isolated rather than force-connected. C10 (formerly C9) removes the P96->P97 edge, correctly treating decomposition-quality isolation and retriever-agnosticism as parallel, coordinate effects of using a fixed evidence document rather than a causal chain. The remaining low score contributors are the two components with single_run/majority confidence edges only (parts of C1, C3, and the C5 answerability edge at edge_score 7.0), which reflects genuine evidentiary uncertainty in the source paper rather than a structural error in the graph itself.
